experiences.action_result: Found DB connection pool utilization at 98%. Scaled pool size to 300.
experiences.root_cause: Database connection pool exhaustion caused by high concurrent request volume exceeding pool capacity limit of 100 connections.
experiences.resolution: Increased max database connection pool limit to 300 and updated connection timeout threshold.
experiences.lesson: High API latency combined with high DB connection utilization (>95%) should trigger database connection pool investigation before cache scaling.

recent_changes: Rotated auth signing secrets in Kubernetes secret vault
experiences.investigation_action: Inspect Auth JWT Keys & Secret Rotation
experiences.action_result: Synchronized RS256 public key secret across auth gateway pods.
experiences.root_cause: Kubernetes secret vault failed to distribute rotated RS256 public key to auth-gateway replicas.
experiences.resolution: Applied force sync on auth-vault secrets operator and restarted secret watcher daemon.
experiences.lesson: HTTP 401 authorization spikes following secret deployment indicate key sync mismatch, not pod replica exhaustion.
